scope: Each batch is paired within its own eight-repetition ABBA-BAAB or BAAB order. Cumulative Parent->Choice products chain separate Parent->Current and Current->Choice batches; no direct Parent/Choice pair was run.
statistics: Medians of eight independent process samples per side; CV is population stdev/mean. Four counters cover the entire process. RSS review line per protocol is max(3% of left median, 1 MiB); peak footprint is supplementary, not a 3% admission gate.
